title: Physiology-Aware Graph Attention for Early Ventricular Reentry Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.26430v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Sudden cardiac death mostly originates from post-infarct ventricular tachycardia. This reentry is sustained by propagation around scar tissue, but its risk remains difficult to predict from infarct imaging alone. While in silico induction studies can reveal these mechanisms, exploring many substrates and pacing locations remains computationally expensive. We propose a graph attention classifier for early prediction of sustained ventricular reentry from simulated cardiac electrophysiology. Each simulation is represented as a graph with early nodal voltage samples and edge attributes encoding geometry, stimulation frequency, tissue labels, amplitude, and diastolic interval. These descriptors are computed only from the first two paced activations, before sustained reentry is observed. On a balanced independent test set of 1000 simulations, the classifier achieves 94.6% accuracy, 95.4% sensitivity, 93.8% specificity, 94.6% F1-score, 0.98

translated_title: 基于生理学感知的图注意力网络用于心室折返的早期预测
translated_abstract: 心源性猝死大多起源于梗死后室性心动过速。这种折返由瘢痕组织周围的电传导所维持，但其风险仍然难以仅凭梗死影像进行预测。虽然计算机模拟诱发研究可以揭示这些机制，但对多种基质和起搏位置的探索计算成本高昂。我们提出了一种图注意力分类器，用于从模拟心脏电生理数据中早期预测持续性心室折返。每个模拟被表示为一个图，其中包含早期节点电压采样以及编码几何形状、刺激频率、组织标签、振幅和舒张间期的边属性。这些描述符仅在观察到持续折返之前，由前两次起搏激活计算得出。在一个包含1000个模拟的平衡独立测试集上，该分类器达到了94.6%的准确率、95.4%的灵敏度、93.8%的特异度、94.6%的F1分数和0.98（的AUC）。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种生理学感知的图注意力分类器，仅利用前两次起搏激活的早期电生理特征即可高精度地预测梗死后的持续性心室折返，准确率达94.6%。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a physiology-aware graph attention classifier that predicts sustained post-infarct ventricular reentry with high accuracy (94.6%) using only early electrophysiological features from the first two paced activations.
